_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_wake_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 390, "sleep_target_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 480, "wind_down_lead_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 45, "breakfast_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, "late_threshold_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "low_energy_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("low_energy_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "capture_shortcut_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("capture_shortcut_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "weekend_leeway_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "wake_goal_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "wake_shift_from_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "wake_shift_start_date" TEXT NULL, "wake_shift_step_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, "wake_shift_every_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "verse_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("verse_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "gate_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("gate_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "morning_lock_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("morning_lock_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "wind_down_lock_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("wind_down_lock_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "unlock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "calendar_synced_at" TEXT NULL, "onboarded_at" TEXT NULL, "light_day_date" TEXT NULL, "steady_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("steady_mode" IN (0, 1)), "steady_offer_dismissed_at" TEXT NULL, "last_opened_at" TEXT NULL, "welcome_back_date" TEXT NULL, "dismissed_suggestions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "school_year_start_month" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weekday_schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_class_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "commute_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "prep_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("weekday"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "submitted_at" TEXT NULL, "submit_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inbox_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "processed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("processed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "top3_task_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "bed_logged_at" TEXT NULL, "wake_logged_at" TEXT NULL, "eat_done_at" TEXT NULL, "routine_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("routine_done" IN (0, 1)), "mood" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "ended_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_notifications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_mutes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "owner_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "class_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "room" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wake', "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("habit_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blocked_apps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "package_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "spent_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "cached_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_at" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("day", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rewards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_needed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "claimed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
